start.text: The white runs back rock to rock toward the spit, into the fog. In the gullies the water is coming back, a little further each time.

choice.text: Go back across before the flood.

back.text: You go back on the white with the flood at your heels. By the spit it's at your ankles; by the time you're up the hard, the Teeth are under again, and the fog has them.
